name: Terminal Dispatch
description: Create and interact with bash, PowerShell, and other shell terminals from within a session. Supports command execution with output capture, human-in-the-loop intervention, and concurrent terminal management.
author: ghola

maxConcurrentTerminals.label: Max Concurrent Terminals
maxConcurrentTerminals.description: Caps how many terminals can exist in the pool at once. When the pool is at capacity, /terminal/create refuses with an error naming the cap instead of creating a new terminal.

defaultShell.label: Default Shell
defaultShell.description: Shell used when a /terminal/create request omits shell; also refused if not present in Allowed Shells. bash (default): Linux/WSL/macOS, has Shell Integration. powershell: Windows PowerShell 5.x, Windows-only. pwsh: PowerShell Core 7.x, cross-platform. zsh: cross-platform, has Shell Integration. cmd: Windows-only, no Shell Integration. fish: cross-platform, has Shell Integration.

autoDisposeOnSessionEnd.label: Auto-dispose terminals when session ends
autoDisposeOnSessionEnd.description: Inert — TerminalManager.dispose(), which runs on extension deactivation, disposes every pooled terminal unconditionally; this flag is stored in config but no code path reads it to gate that behavior. terminal.md documents it as controlling auto-dispose, but restoring the real behavior needs a code change, not a settings change.

commandTimeoutMs.label: Default Command Timeout (ms)
commandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for a /terminal/exec command run without waitForHuman; a per-call timeoutMs overrides it. On timeout the terminal returns to idle and the response reports whatever output was captured with timedOut: true.

humanInterventionTimeoutMs.label: Human Intervention Timeout (ms)
humanInterventionTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a /terminal/exec command sent with waitForHuman: true, longer than Command Timeout since a human needs time to read, respond, and type. On timeout the terminal returns to idle rather than staying blocked, and the response reports the captured output with timedOut: true.
